faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIMA Centre Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIMA Centre Research Fellow posts is 09 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Centre Research Fellow posts in IIMA?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Centre Research Fellow post in the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad Recruitment 2026. This is a contract-based government job opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIMA Centre Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIMA Centre Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any charges.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the Centre Research Fellow post at IIMA?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD (or equivalent doctoral qualification) in Finance, Economics, or a closely related field from a top-tier institution in India or abroad to be eligible for the Centre Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for Centre Research Fellow in IIMA?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Centre Research Fellow post at IIMA primarily involves an Application Review. Further details, if any, will be mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the IIMA Centre Research Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of IIMA or by using the direct apply link provided in the Important Links section of the article. Ensure all details are filled correctly.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Centre Research Fellow position at IIMA is a Contract-based job. It offers an opportunity to work with a prestigious government institution on a contractual basis.

faq.answer: The job location for the Centre Research Fellow post is Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad is located in this city.
